title: 雨の日のアンアーカイブ
author: 鏡 ミライ

en.title: The Rainy Day Unarchive
en.premise: In an era where AI optimizes and edits every memory, humanity is on the verge of losing the ability to feel "boredom" or "sadness." A data organizer discovers an old paper star map containing coordinates absent from any digital map. Only on rainy days, within the glitches of the city's AR signals, a mysterious shop appears. There, she discovers the true luxury of time that goes unrecorded.

zh.title: 雨之日的非存档
zh.premise: 在一个所有记忆都被AI优化与编辑的时代，人们正逐渐失去名为“无聊”与“悲伤”的情感。身为数据整理师的主角，偶然得到了一张记载着数字地图上不存在之坐标的古旧纸质星图。唯有在下雨之日，于都市AR信号紊乱的缝隙中，才会出现一家不可思议的店铺。在那里，她将体会到“不被记录的时间”所带来的奢侈。
